name: lora-plan-a40

scenario.name: lora-plan-a40
scenario.description: Task 8.3 (D42) on one Runpod A40: LoRA adapters for the planner on Qwen3.5-4B (the base 8.1 chose: as accurate as the 9B on dev at about twice the speed), trained on the 8.2 synthetic pairs (train/plans.v1, 2,660 pairs; 5% held out for eval loss) with the compact planner prompt (the service's prompt without the JSON schema and the few-shot bank; ~3.0k characters instead of ~14.7k). Ablation against the baseline all-r16, one variable at a time: data size (500, 1000, all at rank 16) and rank (4, 16, 64 on all pairs). BF16 LoRA (no 4-bit: Unsloth advises against QLoRA on Qwen3.5), attention and MLP projections of the language model, 2 epochs, effective batch 16, loss on the plan tokens only. Then one vLLM server with every adapter records the dev split for each, and two base controls on the same server: the service's full prompt (E-069's configuration) and the compact prompt, so prompt and weights are separate variables. Greedy, structured outputs on, thinking off, as in 8.1. Scored on the laptop by the replayed eval (make eval-replay).
